headline: Farah Irani steps down as Kirloskar Oil Engines compliance officer
hook: Leadership departure at Kirloskar Oil Engines
summary: Kirloskar Oil Engines has announced that Ms Farah Irani will cease to serve as the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the company, effective October 30, 2026. The exchange filing details the upcoming exit but provides no replacement details. For retail investors, senior management and compliance changes in mid-cap engineering firms are routine administrative updates that rarely impact share price performance.
whats_next: Appointment of a new compliance officer before October 2026
why_it_matters: Routine compliance exit with no immediate impact on stock.

headline: CG Power, Kirloskar Oil Engines and three other Nifty 500 stocks test 200-day moving average support
hook: Key technical level tested across five equities
summary: Five stocks within the Nifty 500 index, including CG Power and Kirloskar Oil Engines, are currently taking support at their 200-day moving average. This technical level is closely watched by market participants to gauge long-term trend strength. Retail investors tracking chart-based setups use this moving average to identify potential reversal or consolidation zones. The list highlights specific mid and large-cap equities showing price stabilization at key technical boundaries.
why_it_matters: Technical setups help traders spot potential trend reversals.
